[1/2] Add real display-scaling coverage: --dpr 1.25/1.5/2 emulation in tools/ui_audit.py, radar backing-store verification in every report, a radarDpr severe finding, and a DPR-aware timeout.

impact_assessment.why: G-011 requires a DPR-correct radar at 100-200% Windows scaling, but the audit hard-coded device scale 1, so the radar DPR path had never been exercised by any audit run.
impact_assessment.benefits: Any future cockpit change is checked at the scaling levels Windows actually uses, and a blurry radar now fails --check instead of passing silently at dpr 1.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive report keys (radar, dpr); dependency: Edge/Chrome flags only; concurrency: none; state: none; runtime: a 2x 1080p capture takes ~350s
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure argument builder with unit tests, additive keys, measured timing, timeout scaled by 2*dpr^2 with the effective budget printed

[1/2] Make galactic war news reach the player: summarized AI trade, a priority-aware 20-line log, war/peace/elimination cockpit notifications, and display names in elimination lines.

impact_assessment.why: A 1,200-tick probe generated 1,432 WAR and 62 PEACE lines and ended 17 wars, but the 20-line flight log kept none of them because AI trade emitted two lines per tick, and the cockpit never surfaced war news at all.
impact_assessment.benefits: Players can follow who is fighting, what changed hands and who made peace without opening the Factions tab; the log keeps recent local context instead of drowning in identical trade lines.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new GameEvent kind 'war' in the existing capped event tuple; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: tick path unchanged in ordering; state: flight log contents and event composition change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Small pure module with unit tests, capped and de-duplicated events, measured before/after probe, vision review of the toast stack, full gates

checkpoints.description: [2/2] War news now reaches the player: logbook summarization and priority trimming, 27 war notifications over 1200 ticks, vision APPROVED the two-card stack at 720p/1080p; 707 tests; 4/4 gates. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets).
Task 'galactic-war-news' completed successfully.

[1/6] Plan player-brokered mediation of AI-AI wars: spend credits to push a front toward a ceasefire, earn standing with both belligerents, and surface it in CLI, REST and the cockpit war cards. Also adopt the leftover war-news persistence regression test.

impact_assessment.why: War news made galactic conflict visible (ADR-081), but the player can only bankroll a side or declare/leave their own wars; there is no pacifist lever to stop a war between third parties, and the leftover persistence test would otherwise be lost.
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds a diplomacy-skill and credit sink that ends AI wars, gains standing with both sides, produces peace headlines, and completes the war-news story with player agency.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: status/wars payload and endpoint additions only; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: mutation under engine lock like support_war; state: war score/active/ended_tick already serialized, no schema change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Backward-compatible fields, deterministic score maths, failing-first engine/REST/CLI tests, cockpit contract tests, G-015 vision review, full aikit check
